type_descriptions.SK: SKILL.md packs and plugins that teach an agent a domain or task
type_descriptions.WF: Methods and process packs: spec-driven, planning, TDD, review loops
type_descriptions.HA: Agents you run: terminal and IDE coding agents
type_descriptions.FW: Libraries and SDKs for building your own agents
type_descriptions.MCP: Servers that give agents tools or data over MCP
type_descriptions.INF: Gateways, registries and frameworks for building and running MCP and tools
type_descriptions.SB: Isolated environments where agent code runs
type_descriptions.BR: Browser and desktop control for agents
type_descriptions.SEC: Scanners, red-teaming, guardrails and hardening configs
type_descriptions.CI: Agents that run in GitHub Actions and CI
type_descriptions.MEM: Long-term memory, knowledge graphs and session recall
type_descriptions.GD: Guides, open specs and starter code
type_descriptions.TL: Runners, installers and agent ops tools

clusters.name: Vendor terminal agents
clusters.reason: Reference harness: Apache-2.0 source and the safest defaults (OS sandbox on, network off, OTel off). Claude Code has the richest plugin ecosystem but is proprietary and starts in auto mode

clusters.name: Open, model-agnostic terminal agents (OpenCode lineage)
clusters.reason: Upstream, MIT, and --auto is opt-in; Kilo CLI is a fork of it, and Goose defaults to auto with no sandbox

clusters.name: Cline family (IDE agents)
clusters.reason: Original upstream and actively maintained; Roo Code is archived (shut down 15 May 2026, excluded), Zoo Code is a community fork, Continue's status is unclear. Turn off CLI auto-approve and telemetry

clusters.name: Google pair: Gemini CLI vs Antigravity
clusters.reason: Open source (Apache-2.0) with documented defaults; Antigravity has no license and collects interactions data by default

clusters.name: Skill format and official reference skills
clusters.reason: Same SKILL.md format everywhere: anthropics/skills for the spec and examples, openai/plugins for Codex packaging; openai/skills is deprecated

clusters.name: Project instructions and specs
clusters.reason: Open spec read by Codex, Goose, Cursor and Grok; point Gemini and Claude Code at it with a one-line shim

clusters.name: Vendor plugin marketplaces
clusters.reason: Claude plugin format is the import source; Cursor's repo already ships a .claude-plugin manifest. None pin SHAs, so vet each plugin

clusters.name: AWS
clusters.reason: Current official bundle; it supersedes awslabs/mcp. Scope IAM read-only first

clusters.name: Anthropic learning resources
clusters.reason: Broader and current: agent patterns, skills, memory and tracing

clusters.name: Cross-model review
clusters.reason: Official, one plugin, adds Codex review inside Claude Code; tstack's council does three-model review

clusters.name: Engineering skill packs (pstack family and peers)
clusters.reason: Most complete spec-to-TDD-to-review loop, works across harnesses, Safe; use pstack via cursor/plugins if you are in Cursor

clusters.name: Spec-driven and planning workflows
clusters.reason: Official GitHub, agent-agnostic, lightest path from spec to plan to tasks; ACE-FCA is the best short read on the method

clusters.name: Parallel agents and agent control centers
clusters.reason: Self-hosted, runs any ACP agent including Codex and Claude Code; Symphony is an OpenAI preview for trusted environments

clusters.name: Agent memory
clusters.reason: Simplest SDK for per-user memory in a product (set MEM0_TELEMETRY=False); Basic Memory or Episodic Memory for your own agents' local notes

clusters.name: LLM tracing and observability
clusters.reason: Most adopted self-hostable tracing and evals, plus official Langfuse skills to wire it in; OpenInference/OpenLLMetry if you stay on plain OTel

clusters.name: Agent frameworks
clusters.reason: Builds on the same agent loop you already run in Claude Code; openai-agents-python if you are on OpenAI

clusters.name: Skill installers and skill tooling
clusters.reason: Lockfile and manifest for skills plus MCP; upskill to measure whether a skill helps

clusters.name: Security review skills
clusters.reason: Deepest audit expertise; Snyk recipes if you already use Snyk

clusters.name: MCP and skill scanners
clusters.reason: Fully local static plus YARA scanning with no account; Snyk's sends data to its API

clusters.name: LLM red-teaming and guardrails
clusters.reason: Broadest out-of-the-box probe set for agent endpoints; NeMo Guardrails for runtime blocking

clusters.name: Eval frameworks
clusters.reason: YAML evals plus red-team in CI with no code; DeepEval if you want pytest-style

clusters.name: Browser automation for agents
clusters.reason: Cheapest tokens per step and runs as CLI or MCP; Playwright MCP is the safe default for MCP-only clients

clusters.name: GitHub and CI agents
clusters.reason: Official GitHub, sandboxed safe-outputs model, agent-agnostic

clusters.name: Sandboxes for agent code
clusters.reason: Mature, SDK-first, fast VMs; container-use if you want local git-branch isolation

clusters.name: Awesome lists and directories
clusters.reason: Vendor-curated; community lists are for discovery only, and ClawHub is rated Avoid

clusters.name: Docs and web to Markdown
clusters.reason: Lightest, broad format support; Docling for hard PDFs

clusters.name: Postgres, Supabase and Neon
clusters.reason: Read-only best-practice skills, no DB access needed

clusters.name: Microsoft and Azure
clusters.reason: Official servers; the skill packs only matter if you use Azure

clusters.name: n8n
clusters.reason: Same author; the MCP server carries the node docs, skills complement it

clusters.name: Design and UI taste skills
clusters.reason: Real components and registry; the two skills have unusual star growth

clusters.name: Database and analytics MCP servers
clusters.reason: Official Google, one server for Postgres, BigQuery, Spanner and more

clusters.name: Cloud and infra MCP servers
clusters.reason: Official remote servers with OAuth, nothing to host; awslabs/mcp is superseded

clusters.name: Work-app MCP servers
clusters.reason: Official and central to a many-PR workflow; Notion's local server is unmaintained (use its hosted MCP)

Fork of Gemini CLI v0.8.2; stopped syncing upstream.
Successor: openai/skills is deprecated in favor of openai/plugins.
letta-ai/letta is now a pointer repo; Letta Code replaces it (old entry removed).
Same author; Probity supersedes TDD Guard.
